title: Mission: The Dragster
subtitle: Built for a straight-line race
summary: Explore the parts of a dragster and compare travel time over a fixed distance.
activityInstruction: Predict which speed takes less time. Run both tests over the same distance, compare the times, then finish your investigation.

storyQuestions.success: The children went to a race.
The teacher went with the children.

storyQuestions.prompt: What were the cars waiting for?
storyQuestions.success: The cars were waiting for the start.
No, not all the cars were fast.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do we want our car to do?
storyQuestions.success: We want our car to go faster.
The motor makes a car move.

storyQuestions.prompt: What parts turn when a car moves?
storyQuestions.success: The wheels turn when a car moves.

storyQuestions.prompt: Can we change the motor power?
storyQuestions.success: Yes, we can change the motor power.

storyQuestions.prompt: What can we change to make it faster?
storyQuestions.success: We can change the power or the gears to make it faster.

storyQuestions.prompt: How can we find out if our idea works?
storyQuestions.success: We can test to find out if our idea works.

parts.label: Front wheels
parts.fact: The small front wheels help guide the dragster.
parts.help: Find the two small wheels at the long nose.

parts.label: Rear wheels
parts.fact: Wide rear tyres grip the track and transfer turning force to the ground.
parts.help: Find the two wide tyres beside the engine.

parts.label: Engine
parts.fact: The engine supplies power to turn the rear wheels.
parts.help: Find the exposed engine behind the driver.

parts.label: Rear wing
parts.fact: The rear wing creates downforce to help the rear tyres grip.
parts.help: Find the raised wing above the back of the car.

exploreInstruction: Rotate the car to view it from every side. Zoom in to take a closer look, or use fullscreen for a larger view.
codingInstruction: Build your dragster program step by step, then try your own ideas. Choose Full program to see all the blocks together.
